topic: Practical on aircraft connectors like pin configuration, insertion and exertion of connector pins, insulation check.
syllabus_extract: Practical on aircraft connectors like pin configuration, insertion and exertion of connector pins, insulation check.
specific_objectives: 19.1.1.1Trainee will be able to explain aircraft wiring and Causes of wiring degradation.

training_aids.remarks: Refer to the master syllabus reference list
Objective: teach the syllabus extract for this lesson

practical: Demonstration and practice of pin configuration identification, safe insertion and exertion of connector pins, and insulation resistance checking using multimeter on training connectors.
intro_questions: What are the primary causes of aircraft wiring degradation?
Why is correct pin configuration critical for electrical safety?
What safety precautions must be taken before handling aircraft connectors?

development.content:
Pin configuration identification
Connector pin insertion procedure
Exertion of connector pins
Insulation check methodology
Safety precautions during handling

Troubleshooting common connector faults
Verification of insulation resistance values
Documentation of connector status
Handling damaged pins safely
Review of wiring degradation causes

Final inspection of connector assembly
Comparison with standard wiring diagrams
Reporting of anomalies found
Reinforcement of safety protocols
Preparation for next lesson

summary_questions: Explain the steps involved in the safe insertion of aircraft connector pins.
Describe the procedure for performing an insulation check on a connector.
List three causes of wiring degradation and their potential impacts.
home_assignment_question: Prepare a brief report on the importance of maintaining proper pin configuration in aircraft wiring systems, referencing the procedures learned in this lesson and linking to the next lesson plan (LP 02) on advanced wiring diagnostics.
